acceptedUI.scope: Historical original UI portable/controller acceptance only; new metadata projection requires distinct conservation review; native unproven

acceptedGate.scope: Bounded gate-format/freshness/cleanup acceptance only; not this new harness

appSourceConservation: All application source except the declared world-model.ts metadata-admission binding and the reversible world-ui.ts selection-race repair remains byte-identical to the accepted historical UI. All source contracts, factual packet, anchors, projected metadata, root acceptance, CSS, geometry and readable fallback are unchanged. The interactive index and fixture are rebuilt with current pins; no production importer or runtime test hooks were added.

launchLineage.historicalOutcome: Downloaded Chromium sandbox start failed; a later installed Chrome channel launch succeeded with sandboxEnabled true and browserVersion 155.0.8059.39. That is historical evidence, not this package execution.
launchLineage.newPolicy: One installed Chrome channel attempt at /opt/google/chrome/chrome; sandbox enabled; no fallback. The future run records its own executable digest and actual browser version.

excludedFromThisComposition: All intermediate reader HTML/builds and old raw evidence trees
Unrelated inherited corporate/India geography crosswalk metadata
Internal local reviews and scratch notes
Raw source PDF/email bodies and broader unadmitted research

controllerSuccessor.scope: Controlled-layout old-bundle reproduction and successor regression; actual browser validation is still required.

axFormatSuccessor.scope: Every raw row remains intact and receives the original content, size and recursion validation. Only canonical-JSON-equal complete repeated rows are supported; conflicting ID reuse still fails. This is a bounded producer-format rule, not arbitrary-content privacy certification.

historicalGateDelta: GATE-DELTA.json is the retained original composition proposal. Current manifest.json is authoritative for current shipped bytes; later diagnostic and selection-race changes are separately declared here.
historicalProjectionDeclaration: PUBLIC-PROJECTION.json is the unchanged initial metadata-only proposal. Its unchangedApplicationAreas describe that historical delta. Current controller conservation is separately defined in PROJECTION-CONSERVATION.json v2.
